name: ChaptarrNG
description: Built on .NET 10 LTS, ChaptarrNG manages audiobook and eBook libraries with format-aware automation and optional SeerrNG integration.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent ChaptarrNG database, settings, and logs.

paths.name: Audiobooks
paths.description: Audiobook library path. Configure this path as an audiobook root folder in ChaptarrNG.

paths.name: eBooks
paths.description: eBook library path. Configure this path as an ebook root folder in ChaptarrNG.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the ChaptarrNG web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UID used by the container. Match this to the owner of the mapped folders.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: GID used by the container. Match this to the group of the mapped folders.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Optional file-creation mask. Use 002 when a shared group needs write access.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone, using a TZ database name.
